_note: Seven broad labels derived from the frozen 20-label taxonomy. This taxonomy was selected after the original benchmark and is exploratory, not an independent confirmation result.
_supervision_note: Candidates receive only each reduced label's name, question, and boundary. No fixture URL, title, domain, rationale, or example is present in this file.
_mapping_note: source_labels defines a deterministic many-to-one projection from the original gold labels. A row with no in-scope source label maps to unclassified. No row is relabelled by model output.

core.name: Communication & Social
core.question: Which communication or social services appear in the browsing history?
core.boundary: Webmail, chat, voice, meetings, social networks, forums, communities, professional networks, blogs, and dating services.

core.name: Search, Reference & Education
core.question: What did the subject search for, research, or learn?
core.boundary: Search results, reference material, courses, academic sites, institutional sites, and instructional material.

core.name: News & Entertainment
core.question: What news or leisure content did the subject consume?
core.boundary: Press, current affairs, video, audio, music, film, television, sport, games, humour, celebrity, comics, and animation.

core.name: Technology, Work & File Transfer
core.question: Which technology, work, development, storage, or transfer services appear?
core.boundary: Software, developer resources, product documentation, administration tools, code hosting, cloud storage, document collaboration, and file transfer.

core.name: Shopping & Finance
core.question: Which purchases, marketplaces, banks, payments, or financial services appear?
core.boundary: Retail, auctions, classifieds, marketplaces, property listings, banking, payments, brokerage, insurance, tax, and accounting.

core.name: Travel, Transport & Accommodation
core.question: Does the browsing history show travel, routing, transport, or accommodation?
core.boundary: Booking services, carriers, accommodation, maps, routing, and local transport.

core.name: Unclassified / Outside reduced scope
core.question: Does this row lack enough signal, or fall outside the six displayed categories?
core.boundary: Rows with insufficient signal and rows whose only original labels are outside this reduced taxonomy. This is a catch-all, not a content claim.
